critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~3710 lines. The AI prescreen + helpers block (lines 1144-1423, ~280 lines) is mature enough to extract into /app/backend/ai_kyc_prescreen.py — would isolate the prompt/extraction logic and ease future LLM swaps.
_ai_screen_doc still iterates docs sequentially (~3-8s/doc). When a contact has 5+ docs the wall-clock grows linearly. Recommend asyncio.gather() with bounded concurrency (e.g. 4).
_download_admin_doc still has no size cap on the NamedTemporaryFile write — same disk-fill risk flagged in iter 7. Add a max-bytes guard.

ALLOWED extracted-keys whitelist is duplicated as a local set inside _ai_screen_doc (server.py:1300-1305) and again in the pytest. Consider hoisting to a module-level constant AI_EXTRACTED_FIELDS so the FE/BE/test stay in sync.

ai_prescreen_kyc merges with prior_fields (server.py:1401-1402) — `merged_fields = {**prior_fields, **aggregated_fields}` means a NEW approved-doc value silently overwrites an older one for the same field key. The spec says 'first non-empty value wins' but the merge order here means LAST-RUN wins. If rep re-scans after the doc was re-uploaded with corrected info, the new value will (correctly) overwrite — but if a fresh approved doc on a different field-source has stale info, it overwrites silently. Worth confirming with product.

Aggregation never includes the source_doc_id/source_kind metadata in ai_extracted_fields when stored — actually it does (good!), but the FE renderer (KycMirrorCard.jsx:177-184) only shows `info.value` and ignores source_kind. Consider showing 'from RC' / 'from PAN' subscript so the rep can trace which doc each field came from.

Frontend: KycMirrorCard.jsx is now 478 lines and growing — consider splitting the per-doc card + extracted line + use-suggestion link into a small <KycDocCard> child to keep load() / runAiPrescreen logic isolated.

Per-doc Extracted line (KycMirrorCard.jsx:296) uses border-current/15 — on the red 'Reject' background the divider line is almost invisible. Minor — but consider explicit `border-red-200`/`border-yellow-200` per recommendation color.
